pointy ears peeping out. Our nose is snub, our face is wide, but women like us all the same.

@@U02479@@
A satyr, I hop behind him on goat’s feet and scrawny legs that suit me just fine. For chamoislike, to amuse myself, I climb high peaks to survey the world.

@@U02481@@
Here we little gnomes come tripping, not in pairs, but one by one, crissing and crossing as we foot it.

@@U02483@@
(Surrounding great PAN.)

@@U02484@@
Great Pan is here! Great Pan is come! Great Pan who is All! Surround him, nymphs, with happy dance, float about him, circle him round! He may be earnest, but he’s kindly, too, and he wishes us all to be merry. He would be watchful, would be ever attentive, beneath the blue of heaven's arch, except that brooklets ripple past, and gentle, soft breezes caress him to drowse. And when at noon he sleeps, no leaf stirs, and in the silent, motionless air the healthy scent of Nature hovers, and no nymph dare stay awake, but falls asleep just where she stands. Suddenly then his voice cries out like lightning’s crash, like the roaring sea, and panic descends on even the mightiest, armies scatter and heroes tremble.
translation:
@@U02477@@
尖尖的耳朵向外张望。我们的鼻子是塌下来的，我们的脸是宽的，但女人都喜欢我们。

@@U02479@@
作为色狼，我踩着山羊脚和骨瘦如柴的腿跳到他身后，这很适合我。为了像羚羊一样，为了自娱自乐，我爬上高峰来观察世界。

@@U02481@@
我们这些小侏儒绊倒地来到这里，不是成双成对，而是一个接一个地走来走去，一路走来走去。

@@U02483@@
（周围有很棒的 PAN。）

@@U02484@@
大锅来了！大潘来了！伟大的潘就是一切！围绕着他，仙女们，用快乐的舞蹈，在他周围漂浮，围绕着他！他可能很认真，但他也很友善，他希望我们大家都快乐。在蓝色的天堂拱门下，他会保持警惕，永远专心，只有小溪潺潺流过，轻柔的微风抚摸着他，让他入睡。当他中午睡着的时候，没有树叶摇动，在寂静、静止的空气中盘旋着大自然健康的香气，没有哪个仙女敢保持清醒，而是在她站着的地方睡着了。忽然，他的声音大喊，如雷电轰鸣，如大海咆哮，连强者都惊慌失措，军队溃散，英雄颤抖。
